title: Junior World Championship Squad Begins Training at NCE Guwahati
indian_angle: This camp is crucial for preparing India's top junior talent for the upcoming BWF World Junior Championships in Cairo, Egypt.
summary: India's junior badminton squad has commenced its national coaching camp at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati, focusing on intensive training ahead of the BWF World Junior Championships 2026.

title: BAI Invites Applications for Players of Outstanding Merit
indian_angle: Indian players with exceptional achievements are encouraged to apply for this recognition, which can provide significant support and opportunities.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) has opened applications for players demonstrating outstanding merit, a program designed to recognize and support top-performing Indian athletes.

title: Advanced Coaches Course Held in Guwahati and Raipur
indian_angle: This advanced course aims to elevate the coaching standards across India, directly impacting the development of future Indian badminton stars.
summary: The Badminton Association of India successfully conducted its Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati and Raipur from September 14th to 23rd, 2026.

title: Regulations Released for Inter State Team Championships 2026
indian_angle: The release of regulations for this championship sets the stage for a major domestic tournament where states compete for national glory.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has issued the official regulations for the upcoming Inter State Team Championships 2026, outlining rules and procedures for the prestigious domestic event.

title: India's U17 & U15 Junior Squads Begin Asia Championship Camp
indian_angle: This coaching camp is vital for preparing India's promising U17 and U15 junior players for the Badminton Asia Junior Championships.
summary: A national coaching camp for the Indian U17 and U15 junior badminton teams has commenced at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati, in preparation for the Badminton Asia Junior Championships 2026.

title: BAI Implements 3x15 Scoring for Junior Domestic Tournaments
indian_angle: This new scoring system will significantly impact how junior domestic tournaments are played, influencing player strategy and development in India.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has announced the implementation of the 3x15 scoring system for all domestic ranking tournaments and National Championships across U-13, U-15, and U-17 age groups.
